name: past-limit
what: A lead is still working past the task time limit in settings.

name: ci-red-default
what: The newest decisive CI run of a workflow on the default branch did not succeed.

name: dispatcher-missing
what: Tasks are live but there is not exactly one unfinished session named as the dispatcher.

name: quiet
what: A working lead has written no transcript line and made no commit for more than the threshold, in minutes.

name: ended-undeclared
what: A lead's session ended without it declaring a hand-over or a block, and nothing has happened for more than the threshold, in minutes.

name: blocked-unanswered
what: A lead declared itself blocked more than the threshold, in minutes, ago and is still blocked.

name: handover-unacknowledged
what: A lead handed its work over more than the threshold, in hours, ago and nobody has acknowledged it.

name: busy-after-handover
what: A lead declared a hand-over more than the threshold, in minutes, ago and its session is still not finished; the finding names the processes below it. Checked on every tick.

name: review-loops
what: A task has had at least the threshold number of reviewer dispatches since it started.

name: wrong-model
what: A subagent or lead ran on a model other than the one pinned for its role.

name: ci-red-handover
what: A task handed over a pull request that has a failing check.

name: deep-stack
what: A task's stack, counting the task itself, is more than the threshold tasks deep.

name: merged-not-cleaned
what: A task's pull request was merged, or the task was settled, more than the threshold, in hours, ago and it has not been cleaned.

name: lgtm-blocked
what: A lander run stopped on a pull request the human approved (a review or an lgtm), and the pull request is still open at the head it stopped on; the stop's kind is the subject.

name: base-merged
what: A working or blocked task is stacked on a branch whose pull request has been merged into the default branch.

name: cost-outlier
what: A working or blocked task has cost more than the threshold times the median cost of the repository's landed tasks (those with a merged pull request), as the monitor prices them.

name: lead-heavy
what: A working or blocked task that has cost at least the median landed task has more than the threshold, in percent, of its cost in the lead's own session instead of its subagents.

name: mix-shift
what: A token class's share of the cost of the tasks landed since the last digest differs from its share over the landed tasks before them by at least the threshold, in percentage points; the class with the largest change.

name: dearest-task
what: The dearest task landed since the last digest cost more than the threshold times the median cost of the landed tasks before them; the role that explains most of it is named.

name: role-growing
what: A role present in at least 3 tasks landed since the last digest and 3 before them has a median context per call, or a median number of own tool calls, more than the threshold, in percent, above that of the tasks before.

name: version-shift
what: At least 3 tasks landed since the last digest ran on a plugin version no earlier landed task ran on, and their median task cost, lead share of cost or median lead context differs from the earlier tasks' by more than the threshold, in percent.

name: lead-authoring
what: The lead made at least one product-code or test write (Edit or Write) in at least the threshold, in percent, of the tasks landed since the last digest.
